hotel.name: Waldorf Astoria Dubai International Financial Centre

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within 10 minutes of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall and the Museum of the Future.
verified_facts.excerpt: our urban retreat is within 10 minutes of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and The Museum of the Future

verified_facts.text: Every stay includes a dedicated Personal Concierge to help with excursions and special requests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your stay includes a dedicated Personal Concierge on hand to assist with excursions and special requests.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are residential in style, with brass and walnut finishes, marble bathrooms stocked with Aesop products, and floor-to-ceiling windows with 180-degree views of the Dubai skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each features chic brass and walnut finishes, marble bathrooms stocked with Aesop products, and floor-to-ceiling windows for 180-degree views of the Dubai skyline.

verified_facts.text: Bull & Bear, the signature steakhouse, has an Art Deco setting on Level 18 with Burj Khalifa views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our signature restaurant and steakhouse exemplifies culinary excellence, with expertly crafted dishes in an elegant Art Deco setting. Perched on Level 18 with breathtaking Burj Khalifa views

verified_facts.text: St. Trop is a French Riviera-inspired rooftop lounge with a timber deck, pool, whirlpool and skyline views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor a slice of the French Riviera. This chic rooftop lounge has a timber deck, pool, whirlpool, and breathtaking skyline views.

verified_facts.text: Peacock Alley is a lounge and bar serving afternoon tea with sweet and savory bites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in afternoon tea with sweet and savory bites.

verified_facts.text: The Cigar Lounge evokes the 1960s Mad Men era and is hosted by a Cigar Sommelier.
verified_facts.excerpt: Transport yourself to the Mad Men-era in the 1960s at the Cigar Lounge. Join other aficionados in a journey hosted by our Cigar Sommelier.

verified_facts.text: Room service is available 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Room service is available 24 hours a day.

verified_facts.text: The spa's floatation pod offers a sensory deprivation experience with 600 kg of Epsom salt.
verified_facts.excerpt: The floatation pod provides a sensory deprivation experience enhanced by 600 kg of Epsom salt

verified_facts.text: The spa's Couples Suite has two heated quartz sand massage beds and a hydrotherapy bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join a loved one in the Couples Suite, which includes two unique heated quartz sand massage beds and a therapeutic hydro therapy bath.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre has Technogym cardio and strength equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cardio and strength-training equipment by Technogym®

verified_facts.text: Guests can choose from a Pillow Menu, and the Personal Concierge escorts guests to their room on arrival.
verified_facts.excerpt: When you arrive, your Personal Concierge will escort you to your room and attend to your requests during your stay, including the best support for your sleep. Select the perfect pillow from our Pillow Menu

verified_facts.text: Room amenities should be ordered through the Personal Concierge at least 48 hours before arrival.
verified_facts.excerpt: please contact your Personal Concierge a minimum of 48 hours before arrival

verified_facts.text: Interiors were largely designed by American firm Smallwood, Reynolds, Stewart, Stewart & Associates, with LW Design Group responsible for Bull & Bear and St. Trop.
verified_facts.excerpt: Interior design was largely by American firm Smallwood, Reynolds, Stewart, Stewart & Associates, Inc

verified_facts.text: Rooms are a take on an upscale 1960s Manhattan apartment.
verified_facts.excerpt: A fresh take on an upscale '60s style Manhattan apartment.

verified_facts.text: Corner suites have two walls of floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: The corner suites are the ones to bag with two walls of floor-to-ceiling windows.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is across the street from DIFC's main thoroughfare, slightly away from the heaviest footfall.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Waldorf Astoria is across the street from the major thoroughfare of DIFC, so it feels ever-so-slightly away from the heavy footfall of bar-hopping Friday night city folk

verified_facts.text: The lobby is on the 18th floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: its 18th-floor lobby

verified_facts.text: The property displays works by Lebanese artist Imad Bechara.
verified_facts.excerpt: There's pleasing art-gallery feel throughout the property with works by Lebanese artist Imad Bechara.

verified_facts.text: The ground-floor conference rooms include a show kitchen for interactive sessions.
verified_facts.excerpt: including a show-kitchen for more interactive sessions

verified_facts.text: Bull & Bear aims to replicate the original in New York, with dishes such as slow-cooked beef cheek, apple pie and a Waldorf salad.
verified_facts.excerpt: The general idea in restaurant Bull & Bear is to replicate the original in New York, so there’s reassuring dishes to order like slow-cooked beef cheek and apple pie (and a Waldorf salad, naturally)
